title: Simultaneous Bands for Treatment-Effect Curves in Partially Linear Models with Non-Gaussian Treatment Noise
banked_reason: Cold D0.5 review assessed subfield at 6.8, below the field floor of 7; the in-scope empirical-process repair cannot reach field novelty, while the proposed learner-certificate repair is outside the frozen supplied-code model.
gap_reasons: tier=subfield, paper_score_ceiling=6.8, meets_floor=false; required floor/target=field with ceiling_for_field=7.

lem:uniform-bahadur-multiplier still lacks full derivations of selected-score entropy, same-sample plug-in empirical-L2 control, uniform studentization, o(r_n) fallback/bad-event rates, and the complementary-event critical-value moment bound; selector pilot-rate derivation is also abbreviated.
A field-tier lift would require a genuinely new result—e.g. a sharp weak-separation phase diagram or a lower bound essentially driven by persistent code error—or a materially expanded learner model.
proof_attempt_summary: The run constructed a total split-sample contour band and a matching all-band width lower-bound program at r_n=(log n/n)^(beta/(2 beta+1)), using the accepted contour-annihilator bank under a frozen externally certified treatment code. D0.5 accepted the mathematical interface but the cold review placed the result at subfield novelty and identified incomplete empirical-process derivations. Future work should reuse the contour bank and exact-code converse, while fully proving the score-class coupling and adding a genuinely new field-tier axis.
tldr: This note extends the accepted scalar fixed-error contour substrate in \texttt{stat_sa_plm_cumulant_converse_nongaussian_spectral_annihilation}: its noise-only finite bank is inherited, while the new setting is a localized Hölder treatment-slope curve with simultaneous bands. Under fixed order-\(k\) non-Gaussian treatment-noise separation, any frozen code whose conditional \(L^1\) remainder is at most \(\varepsilon_0\) after removal of an admissible Hölder modifier shift can remain persistently imperfect, and localized contour cancellation removes the arbitrary bounded baseline outcome regression without estimating it. The resulting split-sample multiplier band is uniformly simultaneously honest with expected supremum width \((\log n/n)^{\beta/(2\beta+1)}\); a many-location asymmetric-Bernoulli exact-code subexperiment gives the matching lower bound over all measurable honest bands. The contribution is this modifier-localized honest-band and all-band-width extension, not the generic Hölder rate or a replacement scalar \(n^{-1}\) MSE theory.
gap: Published uniform bands for heterogeneous or continuous-treatment causal functions rely on estimated pseudo-outcomes or balancing weights. Existing non-Gaussian structure-agnostic results do not provide a modifier-indexed band under fixed supplied-code error, and the generic confidence-band literature does not provide the same-experiment all-band converse.
fill: The project derives the noise-only bank, a positive admissible error radius, contaminated and localized denominator moduli, selector control, an explicit Hölder bias envelope, a uniform Bahadur and multiplier theorem, an honest minimax-width band, and an all-measurable-band many-bump converse.
